page: Microsoft Azure F8ads_v7 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Fadsv7 family, powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 945 GB of local disk capacity and is Premium Storage capable, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks highlight exceptional single-core capabilities. The server achieves top-tier status in stress-ng single-core CPU performance, single-threaded gzip compression, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression. Multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks, along with PassMark CPU and database operations, also demonstrate average tier performance.

In terms of specialized workloads, the F8ads_v7 shows strong capabilities in lightweight machine learning tasks, scoring in the top tier for text generation and strong tier for prompt processing using a small 135M LLM model. However, performance scales down to average levels for medium 7B LLM models. Given its high clock speed and balanced memory-to-CPU ratio, this instance offers a qualitatively cost-efficient profile for single-threaded execution, lightweight web serving, and general-purpose applications requiring fast sequential processing and local storage.
description: Microsoft Azure F8ads_v7 is an x86_64 general-purpose server instance from the Fadsv7 family, featuring an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor with 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs operating at 4.5 GHz. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB per core, and includes 945 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. Benchmark data indicates top-tier single-core CPU performance and single-threaded compression speeds, alongside average multi-core and memory bandwidth results. The instance also demonstrates strong performance in lightweight LLM inference. This hardware profile makes the F8ads_v7 highly suitable for workloads that benefit from high clock speeds and fast single-threaded execution, such as web serving, database operations, and lightweight machine learning tasks, offering a balanced resource density without the cost of dedicated GPU hardware.
